title: Dutch shipping on Essequibo and Demarare in the Eighteenth Century
descriptions: The dataset contains information on voyages by Dutch ships to Essequibo and Demarare between 1711 and 1784
description: The dataset contains information on voyages by Dutch ships to Essequibo and Demarare between 1711 and 1784

relations.text: Database  Dutch Atlantic connections: the circulation of people, goods and ideas in the Atlantic world, 1600-1795
The data of this dataset are also included in the larger, integrated database "Dutch Atlantic connections: the circulation of people, goods and ideas in the Atlantic world, 1600-1795" (see relation).

data_sources: National Archives The Netherlands, Aanwinsten, VWIS and WIC. Middelburgsche Courant, Amsterdamsche Courant.
